material_delta: Added tools/xeno_grid10_coordination_metrics_v1.py to measure real physical-fabric coordinator fan-in, raw-to-summary byte compression, node-to-coordinator latency, coordinator commit latency, end-to-end latency, and CAS contention from observable JSONL runtime events.

Added fail-closed tests for unknown packets, receive-without-emit, duplicate consumption, unconsumed packets, and negative timing. The measurement component mints zero Physical-GRID10/HCU credit by itself.

Runtime quiescence remains P0 and unresolved because the pinned restart-authority attribution probe still lacks a completed live-host receipt. Repeated metrics refresh commits show the legacy control-plane remains active, but they are not treated as proof of provider use or host identity.

Trigger-2 placeholder namespace blocker materially narrowed after commit 97888f22489bb252c7094185b727c60dc30a8bb3: a deterministic 46-atom split/remap design exists and corpus placeholder ordinals were checked for split-boundary integrity. Full real-tokenizer/artifact/render binding remains open, so no training admission credit changes.
go_frontier: P0 execute read-only restart-authority attribution on the live Clay host; fail closed on unknown ownership
P0 disable only unambiguously Clay-owned restart authority before terminating descendants; prove >=90s zero survivors/descendants/restarts
P0 then run direct/guarded provider gates with zero provider calls and zero secret lookups
P1 return to physical GRID10 and emit the runtime JSONL trace needed by xeno_grid10_coordination_metrics_v1.py
P1 run recursive physical scaling bridge v2 on the exact physical packet set
P1 measure fan-in/compression/latency/contention, then test coordinator crash/replacement and worker rejoin under load
P2 only after those runtime receipts scale beyond N=10 and compare matched-budget challengers
